quiet: Brown and Lee studied insulin dosing in adolescents with diabetes in 2012.
Patel found that sepsis outcomes were worse in elderly patients in 2009.
Garcia showed that poor sleep raises blood pressure in adults.
Kim measured rising ozone levels over Asia for ten years.
Wong asked whether statin use leads to memory loss in older people.
Novak collected meteor fragments in Siberia during the summer.
Ali wrote a guide to infection control for small hospitals.
Chen explained how lipids contribute to heart disease.
